result.notes:
State checked: working tree at commit 35d5bfb. issues.md was being edited by the main session during this check (third pass, I-46 and I-47, citations of new diagnostics). The I-39 section is identical to commit 61841be, every quote above was confirmed present at 35d5bfb, and line numbers are those of 35d5bfb.

Result: no high-severity problem. The conclusion of I-39 is carried faithfully, and each of the five in-place corrections of I-39 has an accurate row in the corrections table (one row's reason is too broad, listed above). Of the 14 report items (6 errors, 8 caveats), 9 are carried correctly: errors 1, 2, 3 and caveats 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8. Error 4 is corrected in I-39 but survives in I-28, in I-03 without a superseding note, and in the manuscript values map. Caveat 5 lost its limit. Error 5 and caveat 4 are not carried. Error 6 was applied to issues.md only, not to the two files the report names. Nothing was flagged as deferred for this report, so not_yet_due is empty; if errors 5 and 6 are meant for the code pass, they need a recorded loose end.

Recomputed here and in agreement with issues.md (scripts recompute1.py to recompute7.py in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-WGBS-gigas-ploidy-desiccation/ed665b6a-3457-5aca-a521-7838dbc31cfa/scratchpad/wf/check-C1-universe/): universe 48,263 lines and 27,469 names; 43,184 annotated mRNAs; 15,715 missing (36.39%); run of 15,666 from XM_011455141.3 to XM_034461018.1 bounded by XM_011455140.3 and XM_034461020.1; 49 others in 24 runs; all 11 per-sequence shares (35.26% on NC_047565.1, 35.75% on NC_047568.1); 9,761 mRNAs of the XM_034 series on NC_047565.1 to NC_047568.1 with none in the universe; 12,139 of 15,666 (77.5%) against 21,642 of 27,469 (78.8%) for the 10x test; 20,202, 14,109 and 20,175 genes; 43,122 as the union of the three universes; 62 absent from all three as 7, 24 and 31; 456 of 622, 930 of 1,237, 91 of 117 genes and 1,419 of 2,348, 3,012 of 4,606, 247 of 379 transcripts from the legacy DML annotation tables; control-only 39,860 and run of 3,257; heat-only 43,118; md5 of the universe file; 4,096 x 1,289,932 = 5,283,561,472; input 1.2% smaller. The only number that did not survive is the genome-order count (listed above).

Not recomputed: the cut line; no request to gannet was made. It is confirmed by the verifier's saved bytes (out/junction_BOTH.bin: a line of XM_011455140.3 cut after 55 bytes, followed by a line of XM_034461020.1) and by the committed output of the new 06_diagnostics/universe_file_cut.R (file size 20,149,928,521 bytes, cut offset 5,283,561,472, checked 2026-11-19). The verifier's saved simulation output was re-analysed: one line cut, a fresh line at byte 561,152 = 4,096 x 137, 10,841 keys missing, tail written.

Where issues.md departs from the report and is right: 'under every collation tested' for the report's 'under any collation'. Where the report is imprecise: its caveat says 'the same transcripts' for the 3,967 stretches, and its list of execution counts ('30 to 33') is 29 to 33 in the notebook.

Smaller points, not listed as problems. (1) 'Of the transcripts of those genes' in Why it matters: the denominators 2,348, 4,606 and 379 are the transcripts with GO terms listed in the legacy DML annotation tables; the 622 and 1,237 genes have 2,366 and 4,660 mRNAs in all, and the rounded shares are the same either way. (2) '77.5% of the missing transcripts' is 12,139 of the 15,666 in the run; for all 15,715 missing it is 12,177, also 77.5%. (3) The same BOTH table is 'files of 19 to 33 GB' in I-35 (text of 2026-11-18, binary gigabytes) and '20 GB' in I-39. (4) I-35 treats the join tables on gannet as redundant intermediates whose cleanup is for the owner. The BOTH table is now the direct evidence for the cause in I-39 and the input of 06_diagnostics/universe_file_cut.R; I-35 should say that it must be kept until its bytes around the cut and its size are archived. (5) I-20 gives 625, 1,246 and 119 genes with GO terms and I-39 gives 622, 1,237 and 117 'by the legacy route'; by the verifier's script 05_dml_genes.R the difference comes from the NM_ names that step 08 repairs, the genes with hyphenated names, and the GO IDs absent from the GOslim table. A clause in I-39 naming the two routes would spare the reader the comparison. (6) Apart from the proposed I-28 row, the changes proposed here alter text written after the verification, which the preamble of the corrections table does not cover.
